name: Naltima 50mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About NALTIMA 50MG TABLET

NALTIMA 50MG TABLET contains Naltrexone, which belongs to the group of medicines called Opiate antagonists. NALTIMA 50MG TABLET is used as a part of a management program to help affected individuals avoid taking opiates (substances that provide relief from pain) and manage them from developing opioid dependence and addiction.

NALTIMA 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Naltrexone hydrochloride. It is also not recommended for use in patients who have opioid addiction (without successful withdrawal) and/or experience acute symptoms of opioid withdrawal (such as paranoia, confusion, tremors, and disorientation). The medicine is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from severe liver or kidney problems and/or acute hepatitis (inflammation of the liver).

Before taking NALTIMA 50MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have intolerance to certain sugars, such as lactose.

NALTIMA 50MG TABLET should be used with caution during pregnancy and by women planning for pregnancy only if it is clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use by breastfeeding women.

The medicine is also not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) and is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of taking NALTIMA 50MG TABLET are anxiety, nervousness, dizziness, abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, and/or constipation. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.

usesDetails:
Uses Of NALTIMA 50MG TABLET
To manage opioid dependence and addiction
Aids in the management program to help affected individuals avoid taking opiates (substances that provide relief from pain)
mechanismOfAction:
How NALTIMA 50MG TABLET Works

NALTIMA 50MG TABLET works by binding to opioid receptors, which leads to reduced opioid cravings and a blockade of the euphoric and sedative effects of opiates, thus aiding the affected individuals in overcoming opioid dependence and addiction.
usageDetails:
How to use NALTIMA 50MG TABLET

Take NALTIMA 50MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

name: Disulfiram 250mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About DISULFIRAM 250MG TABLET

DISULFIRAM 250MG TABLET contains Disulfiram which belongs to the group of medicines called Aldehyde Dehydrogenase Inhibitors. It is used to manage in patients with alcohol dependence (or alcohol addiction). It helps to manage the habit of alcoholism in patients having a habit of drinking excessive alcohol (chronic alcoholism). DISULFIRAM 250MG TABLET helps in reducing alcohol dependence. It creates aversion towards alcohol by creating various unpleasant symptoms (such as flushing, burning sensation, throbbing headache, increased sweating, chest tightness, dizziness, vomiting, visual disturbances and confusion).

Before taking DISULFIRAM 250MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any lung, liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, high or low blood pressure, thyroid problems, brain damage, fits or any mental disorders as a precaution. DISULFIRAM 250MG TABLET should not be used in patients who have already consumed alcohol. It should be used only in patients who have not drunk alcohol for at least 24 hours prior to the first dose.

It is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in children (aged below 18 years). The most common side effects of taking DISULFIRAM 250MG TABLET are drowsiness, tiredness, impotence, low sex drive, headache, sleepiness and metallic taste. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Used to manage in patients with alcohol dependence (or alcohol addiction)
usesDetails:
Uses Of DISULFIRAM 250MG TABLET
Used to manage in patients with alcohol dependence (or alcohol addiction)
mechanismOfAction:
How DISULFIRAM 250MG TABLET Works

DISULFIRAM 250MG TABLET helps in reducing alcohol dependence. It acts by blocking the actions of certain enzymes (such as aldehyde dehydrogenase) within the body that helps in breaking down a substance called acetaldehyde. As a result, it leads to the accumulation of an excessive amount of acetaldehyde in the body causing unpleasant physical reactions (such as flushing, burning sensation, throbbing headache, increased sweating, chest tightness, dizziness, vomiting, visual disturbances and confusion) that can create aversion towards alcohol which will eventually help in quitting alcoholism.
usageDetails:
How to use DISULFIRAM 250MG TABLET

Take DISULFIRAM 250MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Do not consume alcohol for at least 24 hours before taking the first dose of DISULFIRAM 250MG TABLET. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

Others

Have high blood pressure

Have diabetes
Have low blood pressure
Have epilepsy
Have any form of damage in the brain
Have hypothyroidism (low thyroid functions)

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking DISULFIRAM 250MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines such as:

Warfarin (a medicine used to reduce blood clotting)
Medicines used to manage epilepsy (ex. phenytoin and paraldehyde)
Theophylline (a medicine used to manage asthma)
Medicines used to reduce anxiety (such as chlordiazepoxide and diazepam)
Opioid analgesics (used for pain relief) such as pethidine and morphine
Medicines used to stimulate the brain (such as amphetamine, dextroamphetamine)
Medicines used for mental illness (such as pimozide and chlorpromazine)
Medicines used to manage tuberculosis (ex. isoniazid, rifampicin)
Metronidazole (a medicine used for parasite infection)
Amitriptyline (a medicine used to manage depression)
Alcohol-containing medicines (such as cough syrups)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally took more of DISULFIRAM 250MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdose might include nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, diarrhoea, headache, drowsiness, fatigue, mental disorders, tiredness, rapid heartbeat, rapid breathing, high body temperature, low blood pressure, loss of muscle control and/or high blood sugar.

name: Desirox 500mg Tablet 30'S
introduction:
Introduction About DESIROX 500MG TABLET

DESIROX 500MG TABLET contains Deferasirox which belongs to the group of medicines called Iron chelators. DESIROX 500MG TABLET is used to remove chronic iron overload (excess iron in the body) caused by frequent blood transfusions in patients with Beta thalassemia major aged 6 years and older. DESIROX 500MG TABLET is also used to manage chronic iron overload when deferoxamine therapy is contraindicated or inadequate in patients with beta thalassaemia major and other types of anaemia with iron overload caused by repeated blood transfusions and in children 2 to 5 years of age.

DESIROX 500MG TABLET is also used when deferoxamine therapy is contraindicated or inadequate for patients aged 10 years or older who have iron overload associated with non-transfusion-dependent thalassaemia syndromes. Your doctor may advise you to undergo relevant tests to analyze your existing condition and monitor your kidney and liver function during management.

DESIROX 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with moderate to severe kidney disease, severe liver disease, advanced stage of myelodysplastic syndrome (decreased production of blood cells by the bone marrow) or advanced stage of cancer.

Inform your doctor if you have heart disease. DESIROX 500MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women, unless recommended by your doctor. DESIROX 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children under 2 years of age.

The most common side effects of taking DESIROX 500MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, abdominal pain, bloating, constipation, indigestion, rash, itching, headache, and change in liver or kidney function tests or urine tests. Consult your physician if any of your side effects get worse or persists for a longer duration.
uses: Chronic iron overload due to blood transfusion (transfusional haemosiderosis) in patients aged 2 years and above
Chronic iron overload in patients with non-transfusion dependent thalassemia (NTDT) syndromes aged 10 years and older
usesDetails:
Uses Of DESIROX 500MG TABLET

It is used to manage:

Chronic iron overload due to blood transfusion (transfusional haemosiderosis) in patients aged 2 years and above

mechanismOfAction:
How DESIROX 500MG TABLET Works

DESIROX 500MG TABLET works by trapping and removing excess iron from the body, which is then excreted mainly in the form of stools and reduces the risk of organ damage to the liver and heart. As a result, DESIROX 500MG TABLET helps to remove excess iron from the body.
usageDetails:
How to use DESIROX 500MG TABLET

Take DESIROX 500MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your physician will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

Introduction About NICLONZ 2MG PASTILLE

NICLONZ 2MG PASTILLE is a smoking cessation aid used to quit smoking. It manages and relieves the withdrawal symptoms that occurs in people who wish to quit smoking. It also reduces the cravings for smoking when you try to reduce the number of cigarettes that you smoke in a day.

It contains nicotine as an active ingredient. Nicotine helps to quit smoking by replacing the deficient levels of nicotine in your body that happens when you attempt to quit smoking. As a result, it reduces the cravings for smoking and protects your body from the harmful effects of abusive substances (such as tobacco).

Take NICLONZ 2MG PASTILLE as advised by your physician. Before taking NICLONZ 2MG PASTILLE, inform your doctor if you have any heart, liver, or kidney diseases. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, stomach problems, thyroid problems or fits before taking NICLONZ 2MG PASTILLE as a precaution.

Do not take NICLONZ 2MG PASTILLE if you are allergic to nicotine or if you are a child aged below 12 years. Women who are pregnant or breastfeeding must try to quit smoking without using a nicotine replacement therapy. However, if it is not possible, NICLONZ 2MG PASTILLE can be used in such women to quit smoking after consulting their doctor.

The most common side effects of taking NICLONZ 2MG PASTILLE are ulceration of mouth, tongue or throat, hiccups, nausea, increased salivation, and stomach pain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

introduction:
Introduction About ESPERAL TABLET

ESPERAL TABLET contains Disulfiram which belongs to the group of medicines called Aldehyde Dehydrogenase Inhibitors. It is used to manage in patients with alcohol dependence (or alcohol addiction). It helps to manage the habit of alcoholism in patients having a habit of drinking excessive alcohol (chronic alcoholism). ESPERAL TABLET helps in reducing alcohol dependence. It creates aversion towards alcohol by creating various unpleasant symptoms (such as flushing, burning sensation, throbbing headache, increased sweating, chest tightness, dizziness, vomiting, visual disturbances and confusion).

Before taking ESPERAL TABLET inform your doctor if you have any lung, liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, high or low blood pressure, thyroid problems, brain damage, fits or any mental disorders as a precaution. ESPERAL TABLET should not be used in patients who have already consumed alcohol. It should be used only in patients who have not drunk alcohol for at least 24 hours prior to the first dose.

It is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in children (aged below 18 years). The most common side effects of taking ESPERAL TABLET are drowsiness, tiredness, impotence, low sex drive, headache, sleepiness and metallic taste. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Used to manage in patients with alcohol dependence (or alcohol addiction)
usesDetails:
Uses Of ESPERAL TABLET
Used to manage in patients with alcohol dependence (or alcohol addiction)
mechanismOfAction:
How ESPERAL TABLET Works

ESPERAL TABLET helps in reducing alcohol dependence. It acts by blocking the actions of certain enzymes (such as aldehyde dehydrogenase) within the body that helps in breaking down a substance called acetaldehyde. As a result, it leads to the accumulation of an excessive amount of acetaldehyde in the body causing unpleasant physical reactions (such as flushing, burning sensation, throbbing headache, increased sweating, chest tightness, dizziness, vomiting, visual disturbances and confusion) that can create aversion towards alcohol which will eventually help in quitting alcoholism.
usageDetails:
How to use ESPERAL TABLET

Take ESPERAL TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Do not consume alcohol for at least 24 hours before taking the first dose of ESPERAL TABLET. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

Introduction About NICOGUM 4 SUGAR FREE FRESHMINT FLAVOURED CHEW GUM

It avoids and relieves the withdrawal symptoms that occur in people who wish to quit smoking. It also reduces cravings for smoking when you try to reduce the number of cigarettes that you smoke in a day.

Smoking is a harmful practice in which abusive substances (such as tobacco) are burned and ingested in the form of smoke. Tobacco contains a chemical called nicotine, which makes you smoke more. Within seconds of taking a puff, nicotine from the tobacco reaches your brain and increases the release of certain brain chemicals that regulate your mood and behaviour. Over a period, this causes addiction, and your body tends to show cravings for smoking or precipitate withdrawal symptoms if you try to quit smoking.

NICOGUM 4 SUGAR FREE FRESHMINT FLAVOURED CHEW GUM is a nicotine replacement therapy. It helps to quit smoking by replacing the deficient levels of nicotine in your body that happen when you attempt to quit smoking. As a result, it reduces cravings for smoking and protects your body from the harmful effects of abusive substances (such as tobacco).

Chew NICOGUM 4 SUGAR FREE FRESHMINT FLAVOURED CHEW GUM slowly in your mouth. Do not swallow the medicine. Your doctor will decide the number of doses to be taken per day depending upon the number of cigarettes that you smoke in a day.

Before taking NICOGUM 4 SUGAR FREE FRESHMINT FLAVOURED CHEW GUM, inform your doctor if you have any heart, liver, or kidney diseases. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, stomach problems, thyroid problems, or fits before taking NICOGUM 4 SUGAR FREE FRESHMINT FLAVOURED CHEW GUM as a precaution.

Do not take NICOGUM 4 SUGAR FREE FRESHMINT FLAVOURED CHEW GUM if you are allergic to nicotine or if you are a child aged below 12 years. Women who are pregnant or breastfeeding must try to quit smoking without using nicotine replacement therapy. However, if it is not possible, NICOGUM 4 SUGAR FREE FRESHMINT FLAVOURED CHEW GUM can be used by such women to quit smoking after consulting their doctor.

The most common side effects of taking NICOGUM 4 SUGAR FREE FRESHMINT FLAVOURED CHEW GUM are ulceration of the mouth, tongue, or throat, hiccups, nausea, increased salivation, and stomach pain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

Use NICOGUM 4 SUGAR FREE FRESHMINT FLAVOURED CHEW GUM as directed by your physician. Chew NICOGUM 4 SUGAR FREE FRESHMINT FLAVOURED CHEW GUM slowly until the taste becomes strong. Rest the medicine between your gums and cheeks for some time. Chew the medicine once again.

Repeat the same for at least 30 minutes or until the taste of the medicine fades. Do not chew the medicine continuously, as it may release nicotine very quickly. This can also irritate your throat or cause stomach upsets or hiccups.

Your doctor will decide the number of doses of NICOGUM 4 SUGAR FREE FRESHMINT FLAVOURED CHEW GUM to be taken per day depending upon the number of cigarettes that you smoke in a day.

introduction:
Introduction About NICOSIP SUGAR FREE MINT FLAVOUR 2MG GUM

NICOSIP SUGAR FREE MINT FLAVOUR Gum is a smoking cessation aid used to quit smoking. It manages and relieves the withdrawal symptoms that occur in people who wish to quit smoking. It also reduces cravings for smoking when you try to reduce the number of cigarettes that you smoke in a day. It contains nicotine as an active ingredient.

Nicotine helps you quit smoking by replacing the deficient levels of nicotine in your body that happen when you attempt to quit smoking. As a result, it reduces cravings for smoking and protects your body from the harmful effects of abusive substances (such as tobacco).

Use NICOSIP SUGAR FREE MINT FLAVOUR Gum as directed by your physician. Chew the gum slowly till you get the taste of nicotine. Place it between your cheeks and gums. Chew the medicine once again. Repeat the same for at least 30 minutes, or until the taste of the medicine fades.

Before taking NICOSIP SUGAR FREE MINT FLAVOUR Gum, inform your doctor if you have any heart, liver, or kidney diseases, diabetes, stomach problems, thyroid problems, or fits. Do not take NICOSIP SUGAR FREE MINT FLAVOUR Gum if you are allergic to nicotine or if you are a child aged below 12 years.

Women who are pregnant or breastfeeding must try to quit smoking without using nicotine replacement therapy. However, if it is not possible, NICOSIP SUGAR FREE MINT FLAVOUR Gum can be used by such women to quit smoking after consulting their doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About NODICT 50MG TABLET

NODICT 50MG TABLET contains Naltrexone, which belongs to the group of medicines called Opiate antagonists. NODICT 50MG TABLET is used as a part of a management program to help affected individuals avoid taking opiates (substances that provide relief from pain) and manage them from developing opioid dependence and addiction.

NODICT 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Naltrexone hydrochloride. It is also not recommended for use in patients who have opioid addiction (without successful withdrawal) and/or experience acute symptoms of opioid withdrawal (such as paranoia, confusion, tremors, and disorientation). The medicine is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from severe liver or kidney problems and/or acute hepatitis (inflammation of the liver).

Before taking NODICT 50MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have intolerance to certain sugars, such as lactose.

NODICT 50MG TABLET should be used with caution during pregnancy and by women planning for pregnancy only if it is clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use by breastfeeding women.

The medicine is also not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) and is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of taking NODICT 50MG TABLET are anxiety, nervousness, dizziness, abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, and/or constipation. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About DIZONE 250MG TABLET

DIZONE 250MG TABLET contains Disulfiram which belongs to the group of medicines called Aldehyde Dehydrogenase Inhibitors. It is used to manage in patients with alcohol dependence (or alcohol addiction). It helps to manage the habit of alcoholism in patients having a habit of drinking excessive alcohol (chronic alcoholism). DIZONE 250MG TABLET helps in reducing alcohol dependence. It creates aversion towards alcohol by creating various unpleasant symptoms (such as flushing, burning sensation, throbbing headache, increased sweating, chest tightness, dizziness, vomiting, visual disturbances and confusion).

Before taking DIZONE 250MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any lung, liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, high or low blood pressure, thyroid problems, brain damage, fits or any mental disorders as a precaution. DIZONE 250MG TABLET should not be used in patients who have already consumed alcohol. It should be used only in patients who have not drunk alcohol for at least 24 hours prior to the first dose.

It is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in children (aged below 18 years). The most common side effects of taking DIZONE 250MG TABLET are drowsiness, tiredness, impotence, low sex drive, headache, sleepiness and metallic taste. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Used to manage in patients with alcohol dependence (or alcohol addiction)

Uses Of DIZONE 250MG TABLET
Used to manage in patients with alcohol dependence (or alcohol addiction)
mechanismOfAction:
How DIZONE 250MG TABLET Works

DIZONE 250MG TABLET helps in reducing alcohol dependence. It acts by blocking the actions of certain enzymes (such as aldehyde dehydrogenase) within the body that helps in breaking down a substance called acetaldehyde. As a result, it leads to the accumulation of an excessive amount of acetaldehyde in the body causing unpleasant physical reactions (such as flushing, burning sensation, throbbing headache, increased sweating, chest tightness, dizziness, vomiting, visual disturbances and confusion) that can create aversion towards alcohol which will eventually help in quitting alcoholism.

Do not consume alcohol for at least 24 hours before taking the first dose of DIZONE 250MG TABLET. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About NICOTEX PAAN FLAVOUR SUGAR FREE GUMS 4MG TABLET

NICOTEX PAAN FLAVOUR SUGAR FREE GUMS 4MG TABLET contains Nicotine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Smoking Cessation Aids. It is used to quit smoking. It avoids and relieves the withdrawal symptoms that occur in people who wish to quit smoking. It also reduces cravings for smoking when you try to reduce the number of cigarettes that you smoke in a day.

Smoking is a harmful practice in which abusive substances (such as tobacco) are burned and ingested in the form of smoke. Tobacco contains a chemical called nicotine, which makes you smoke more. Within seconds of taking a puff, nicotine from the tobacco reaches your brain and increases the release of certain brain chemicals that regulate your mood and behaviour. Over a period, this causes addiction, and your body tends to show cravings for smoking or precipitate withdrawal symptoms if you try to quit smoking.

NICOTEX PAAN FLAVOUR SUGAR FREE GUMS 4MG TABLET is a nicotine replacement therapy. It helps to quit smoking by replacing the deficient levels of nicotine in your body that happen when you attempt to quit smoking. As a result, it reduces cravings for smoking and protects your body from the harmful effects of abusive substances (such as tobacco).

Chew NICOTEX PAAN FLAVOUR SUGAR FREE GUMS 4MG TABLET slowly in your mouth. Do not swallow the medicine. Your doctor will decide the number of doses to be taken per day depending upon the number of cigarettes that you smoke in a day.

Before taking NICOTEX PAAN FLAVOUR SUGAR FREE GUMS 4MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any heart, liver, or kidney diseases. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, stomach problems, thyroid problems, or fits before taking NICOTEX PAAN FLAVOUR SUGAR FREE GUMS 4MG TABLET as a precaution.

Do not take NICOTEX PAAN FLAVOUR SUGAR FREE GUMS 4MG TABLET if you are allergic to nicotine or if you are a child aged below 12 years. Women who are pregnant or breastfeeding must try to quit smoking without using nicotine replacement therapy. However, if it is not possible, NICOTEX PAAN FLAVOUR SUGAR FREE GUMS 4MG TABLET can be used by such women to quit smoking after consulting their doctor.

The most common side effects of taking NICOTEX PAAN FLAVOUR SUGAR FREE GUMS 4MG TABLET are ulceration of the mouth, tongue, or throat, hiccups, nausea, increased salivation, and stomach pain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

Use NICOTEX PAAN FLAVOUR SUGAR FREE GUMS 4MG TABLET as directed by your physician. Chew NICOTEX PAAN FLAVOUR SUGAR FREE GUMS 4MG TABLET slowly until the taste becomes strong. Rest the medicine between your gums and cheeks for some time. Chew the medicine once again.

Your doctor will decide the number of doses of NICOTEX PAAN FLAVOUR SUGAR FREE GUMS 4MG TABLET to be taken per day depending upon the number of cigarettes that you smoke in a day.

name: Soihenz Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About SOIHENZ TABLET

Soihenz Tablet is a kidney protecting medicine used to manage kidney diseases. It helps in correcting microalbuminuria (protein loss via urine) among patients suffering from diabetic kidney diseases. It contains N-Acetylcysteine and Taurine as active ingredients.

N-Acetylcysteine and taurine are powerful antioxidants. They protect your cells against the damage caused due to oxidative stress and free radicals (toxins). This action helps in managing the kidney cells from getting damaged further. Additionally, N-Acetylcysteine also improves blood supply to the kidneys which makes your kidneys function better.

Before taking Soihenz Tablet inform your doctor if you have acute asthma, allergic eye conditions or any skin allergies as a precaution. Soihenz Tablet is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered necessary by the physician. Avoid concomitant use of Soihenz Tablet with cough medicines and antibiotics as a precaution.

The most common side effects of taking Soihenz Tablet are nausea, vomiting, fever, runny nose, diarrhea, stomach pain, skin rashes, throat irritation, drowsiness, shortness of breath and oral sores. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects troubles you.

introduction:
Introduction About RECOPRESS 250MG TABLET

RECOPRESS 250MG TABLET contains Disulfiram which belongs to the group of medicines called Aldehyde Dehydrogenase Inhibitors. It is used to manage in patients with alcohol dependence (or alcohol addiction). It helps to manage the habit of alcoholism in patients having a habit of drinking excessive alcohol (chronic alcoholism). RECOPRESS 250MG TABLET helps in reducing alcohol dependence. It creates aversion towards alcohol by creating various unpleasant symptoms (such as flushing, burning sensation, throbbing headache, increased sweating, chest tightness, dizziness, vomiting, visual disturbances and confusion).

Before taking RECOPRESS 250MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any lung, liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, high or low blood pressure, thyroid problems, brain damage, fits or any mental disorders as a precaution. RECOPRESS 250MG TABLET should not be used in patients who have already consumed alcohol. It should be used only in patients who have not drunk alcohol for at least 24 hours prior to the first dose.

It is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in children (aged below 18 years). The most common side effects of taking RECOPRESS 250MG TABLET are drowsiness, tiredness, impotence, low sex drive, headache, sleepiness and metallic taste. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How RECOPRESS 250MG TABLET Works

RECOPRESS 250MG TABLET helps in reducing alcohol dependence. It acts by blocking the actions of certain enzymes (such as aldehyde dehydrogenase) within the body that helps in breaking down a substance called acetaldehyde. As a result, it leads to the accumulation of an excessive amount of acetaldehyde in the body causing unpleasant physical reactions (such as flushing, burning sensation, throbbing headache, increased sweating, chest tightness, dizziness, vomiting, visual disturbances and confusion) that can create aversion towards alcohol which will eventually help in quitting alcoholism.

Do not consume alcohol for at least 24 hours before taking the first dose of RECOPRESS 250MG TABLET. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About NICOSIP 4 MG SUGAR FREE MINT FLAVOUR GUM

NICOSIP 4 MG SUGAR FREE MINT FLAVOUR GUM contains Nicotine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Smoking Cessation Aids. It is used to quit smoking. It avoids and relieves the withdrawal symptoms that occur in people who wish to quit smoking. It also reduces cravings for smoking when you try to reduce the number of cigarettes that you smoke in a day.

Smoking is a harmful practice in which abusive substances (such as tobacco) are burned and ingested in the form of smoke. Tobacco contains a chemical called nicotine, which makes you smoke more. Within seconds of taking a puff, nicotine from the tobacco reaches your brain and increases the release of certain brain chemicals that regulate your mood and behaviour. Over a period, this causes addiction, and your body tends to show cravings for smoking or precipitate withdrawal symptoms if you try to quit smoking.

NICOSIP 4 MG SUGAR FREE MINT FLAVOUR GUM is a nicotine replacement therapy. It helps to quit smoking by replacing the deficient levels of nicotine in your body that happen when you attempt to quit smoking. As a result, it reduces cravings for smoking and protects your body from the harmful effects of abusive substances (such as tobacco).

Chew NICOSIP 4 MG SUGAR FREE MINT FLAVOUR GUM slowly in your mouth. Do not swallow the medicine. Your doctor will decide the number of doses to be taken per day depending upon the number of cigarettes that you smoke in a day.

Before taking NICOSIP 4 MG SUGAR FREE MINT FLAVOUR GUM, inform your doctor if you have any heart, liver, or kidney diseases. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, stomach problems, thyroid problems, or fits before taking NICOSIP 4 MG SUGAR FREE MINT FLAVOUR GUM as a precaution.

Do not take NICOSIP 4 MG SUGAR FREE MINT FLAVOUR GUM if you are allergic to nicotine or if you are a child aged below 12 years. Women who are pregnant or breastfeeding must try to quit smoking without using nicotine replacement therapy. However, if it is not possible, NICOSIP 4 MG SUGAR FREE MINT FLAVOUR GUM can be used by such women to quit smoking after consulting their doctor.

The most common side effects of taking NICOSIP 4 MG SUGAR FREE MINT FLAVOUR GUM are ulceration of the mouth, tongue, or throat, hiccups, nausea, increased salivation, and stomach pain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About ACAMPROL 333MG TABLET

ACAMPROL 333MG TABLET contains Acamprosate which belongs to the group of medicines called Psychiatry agents. It is used for patients with alcohol dependence by helping them abstain from drinking alcoholic drinks. ACAMPROL 333MG TABLET together with counselling will helps not to drink alcohol. Alcohol dependence is a chronic condition that usually includes a current or previous history of uncontrolled drinking, a strong craving for alcohol, continued use despite constant problems with drinking, and an inability to control the consumption of alcohol. It is characterized by symptoms like slurred speech, ataxia (loss of control over body movements), sleepiness, nausea, vomiting, hallucinations, or seizures (fits).

Acamprosate works by activating Gamma Aminobutyric Acid (GABA) receptors in the brain and exerting a controlling influence on alcohol cravings. It also stabilizes the chemical changes in the brain that have taken place during alcohol consumption. ACAMPROL 333MG TABLET will be less effective if you keep drinking alcohol, so avoid consumption of alcohol while taking it.

Before taking ACAMPROL 333MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart disease. ACAMPROL 333MG TABLET is not recommended for pregnant or breastfeeding women, children, or elderly, therefore consult your doctor before taking it. The most common side effects of taking ACAMPROL 333MG TABLET are diarrhoea, stomach pain, nausea, gas, skin rash, or decreased sexual desire. Inform your doctor if any of these side effects gets worse.

introduction:
Introduction About NICLONZ 4MG PASTILLE

NICLONZ 4MG PASTILLE contains Nicotine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Smoking Cessation Aids. It is used to quit smoking. It avoids and relieves the withdrawal symptoms that occur in people who wish to quit smoking. It also reduces cravings for smoking when you try to reduce the number of cigarettes that you smoke in a day.

Smoking is a harmful practice in which abusive substances (such as tobacco) are burned and ingested in the form of smoke. Tobacco contains a chemical called nicotine, which makes you smoke more. Within seconds of taking a puff, nicotine from the tobacco reaches your brain and increases the release of certain brain chemicals that regulate your mood and behaviour. Over a period, this causes addiction, and your body tends to show cravings for smoking or precipitate withdrawal symptoms if you try to quit smoking.

NICLONZ 4MG PASTILLE is a nicotine replacement therapy. It helps to quit smoking by replacing the deficient levels of nicotine in your body that happen when you attempt to quit smoking. As a result, it reduces cravings for smoking and protects your body from the harmful effects of abusive substances (such as tobacco).

Before taking NICLONZ 4MG PASTILLE, inform your doctor if you have any heart, liver, or kidney diseases. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, stomach problems, thyroid problems, or fits before taking NICLONZ 4MG PASTILLE as a precaution.

Do not take NICLONZ 4MG PASTILLE if you are allergic to nicotine or if you are a child aged below 12 years. Women who are pregnant or breastfeeding must try to quit smoking without using nicotine replacement therapy. However, if it is not possible, NICLONZ 4MG PASTILLE can be used by such women to quit smoking after consulting their doctor.

The most common side effects of taking NICLONZ 4MG PASTILLE are ulceration of mouth, tongue, or throat, hiccups, nausea, increased salivation, or stomach pain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About ACAMPTAS 333MG TABLET

ACAMPTAS 333MG TABLET contains Acamprosate which belongs to the group of medicines called Psychiatry agents. It is used for patients with alcohol dependence by helping them abstain from drinking alcoholic drinks. ACAMPTAS 333MG TABLET together with counselling will helps not to drink alcohol. Alcohol dependence is a chronic condition that usually includes a current or previous history of uncontrolled drinking, a strong craving for alcohol, continued use despite constant problems with drinking, and an inability to control the consumption of alcohol. It is characterized by symptoms like slurred speech, ataxia (loss of control over body movements), sleepiness, nausea, vomiting, hallucinations, or seizures (fits).

Acamprosate works by activating Gamma Aminobutyric Acid (GABA) receptors in the brain and exerting a controlling influence on alcohol cravings. It also stabilizes the chemical changes in the brain that have taken place during alcohol consumption. ACAMPTAS 333MG TABLET will be less effective if you keep drinking alcohol, so avoid consumption of alcohol while taking it.

Before taking ACAMPTAS 333MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart disease. ACAMPTAS 333MG TABLET is not recommended for pregnant or breastfeeding women, children, or elderly, therefore consult your doctor before taking it. The most common side effects of taking ACAMPTAS 333MG TABLET are diarrhoea, stomach pain, nausea, gas, skin rash, or decreased sexual desire. Inform your doctor if any of these side effects gets worse.

introduction:
Introduction About 2BACONIL ICY MINT 4MG CHEW GUM

2BACONIL ICY MINT 4MG CHEW GUM contains Nicotine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Smoking Cessation Aids. It is used to quit smoking. It avoids and relieves the withdrawal symptoms that occur in people who wish to quit smoking. It also reduces cravings for smoking when you try to reduce the number of cigarettes that you smoke in a day.

Smoking is a harmful practice in which abusive substances (such as tobacco) are burned and ingested in the form of smoke. Tobacco contains a chemical called nicotine, which makes you smoke more. Within seconds of taking a puff, nicotine from the tobacco reaches your brain and increases the release of certain brain chemicals that regulate your mood and behaviour. Over a period, this causes addiction, and your body tends to show cravings for smoking or precipitate withdrawal symptoms if you try to quit smoking.

2BACONIL ICY MINT 4MG CHEW GUM is a nicotine replacement therapy. It helps to quit smoking by replacing the deficient levels of nicotine in your body that happen when you attempt to quit smoking. As a result, it reduces cravings for smoking and protects your body from the harmful effects of abusive substances (such as tobacco).

Chew 2BACONIL ICY MINT 4MG CHEW GUM slowly in your mouth. Do not swallow the medicine. Your doctor will decide the number of doses to be taken per day depending upon the number of cigarettes that you smoke in a day.

Before taking 2BACONIL ICY MINT 4MG CHEW GUM, inform your doctor if you have any heart, liver, or kidney diseases. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, stomach problems, thyroid problems, or fits before taking 2BACONIL ICY MINT 4MG CHEW GUM as a precaution.

Do not take 2BACONIL ICY MINT 4MG CHEW GUM if you are allergic to nicotine or if you are a child aged below 12 years. Women who are pregnant or breastfeeding must try to quit smoking without using nicotine replacement therapy. However, if it is not possible, 2BACONIL ICY MINT 4MG CHEW GUM can be used by such women to quit smoking after consulting their doctor.

The most common side effects of taking 2BACONIL ICY MINT 4MG CHEW GUM are ulceration of the mouth, tongue, or throat, hiccups, nausea, increased salivation, and stomach pain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

name: Acutrol 400mg Tablet 15'S
introduction:
Introduction About ACUTROL 400MG TABLET

ACUTROL 400MG TABLET contains Sevelamer, which belongs to the group of medicines called Phosphate Binding Agents. It is used to control the serum phosphorous levels in patients with long-term kidney disease who are on dialysis. Renal failure is the most common cause of high phosphorous levels, as there is reduced filtration of inorganic phosphate, increasing its serum levels.

During management, your doctor might ask you to take certain tests to avoid any untoward side effects. Follow the diet as advised by your doctor.

ACUTROL 400MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with low levels of phosphorus in the blood or bowel obstruction. ACUTROL 400MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients who have trouble swallowing, motility problems in the stomach and bowel, and in those who have undergone major bowel surgery.

ACUTROL 400MG TABLET should be used in pregnant women only if your doctor finds it clearly necessary. It is unknown whether ACUTROL 400MG TABLET is excreted in breast milk and may affect your baby, so consult your doctor before taking it during breastfeeding.  ACUTROL 400MG TABLET is not intended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking ACUTROL 400MG TABLET are constipation, vomiting, upper abdominal pain, nausea, diarrhea, indigestion, flatulence (gas), etc. Ask for your doctor’s advice if any of these worsen or don’t improve.

mechanismOfAction:
How ACUTROL 400MG TABLET Works

ACUTROL 400MG TABLET is a chelating agent that helps in reducing the phosphorus levels in the blood by binding to the phosphate that enters the body with food and managing its absorption.
usageDetails:
How to use ACUTROL 400MG TABLET

Take ACUTROL 400MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow it with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide an appropriate dose and duration of ACUTROL 400MG TABLET for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition. Do not stop taking ACUTROL 400MG TABLET unless your doctor advises you to stop.

Introduction About OXITRES 600MG TABLET

OXITRES 600MG TABLET contains Acetylcysteine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Mucolytics. It is used in adults to manage acute airway diseases such as bronchitis (inflammation of the mucous membrane in the airways), emphysema, mucoviscidosis (cystic fibrosis), and/or bronchiectasis (chronic widening of the airway passage).

OXITRES 600MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Acetylcysteine. It is also not recommended for use in patients with bronchial asthma. Before taking OXITRES 600MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have stomach ulcers, liver diseases (such as non-alcoholic fatty acid disease), or chronic kidney disease.

OXITRES 600MG TABLET should be used with caution by pregnant and breastfeeding women only if it is clearly necessary. This medicine is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years) and is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 60 years) after consulting your doctor. The most common side effects of taking OXITRES 600MG TABLET are nausea and vomiting. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.

Introduction About RYZE 4 MG ROYAL PAAN NICOTINE GUM

RYZE 4 MG ROYAL PAAN NICOTINE GUM is designed to support individuals who are working towards reducing nicotine dependence. RYZE 4 MG ROYAL PAAN NICOTINE GUM offer a refreshing mint flavour and easy-to-use format. It is ideal for adults who are looking for a smoke-free alternative that can be used discreetly during work, travel, or social interactions.

The sugar-free formulation helps those mindful of calorie intake, and the 4mg strength is generally suited for individuals who used to consume more than 20 cigarettes a day. Always follow your healthcare provider’s guidance on dosage and usage schedule.

RYZE 4 MG ROYAL PAAN NICOTINE GUM is a nicotine replacement therapy. It helps to quit smoking by replacing the deficient levels of nicotine in your body that happen when you attempt to quit smoking. As a result, it reduces cravings for smoking and protects your body from the harmful effects of abusive substances.

Chew the gum slowly until you experience a peppery taste or mild tingling. Park the gum between your cheek and gums. Repeat the chewing-parking cycle for about 30 minutes. Avoid eating or drinking anything acidic (like coffee, soft drinks) 15 minutes before or after use.

Before using RYZE 4 MG ROYAL PAAN NICOTINE GUM inform your healthcare provider if you are pregnant, breastfeeding, or have underlying conditions. Do not use if you are allergic to nicotine.  

While many individuals may use RYZE 4 MG ROYAL PAAN NICOTINE GUM without notable concerns, some may experience mild effects, especially in the initial phase of use. Always follow usage directions and consult a healthcare professional in case of any discomfort.

introduction:
Introduction About DESIROX 250MG TABLET

DESIROX 250MG TABLET contains Deferasirox which belongs to the group of medicines called Iron chelators. DESIROX 250MG TABLET is used to remove chronic iron overload (excess iron in the body) caused by frequent blood transfusions in patients with Beta thalassemia major aged 6 years and older. DESIROX 250MG TABLET is also used to manage chronic iron overload when deferoxamine therapy is contraindicated or inadequate in patients with beta thalassaemia major and other types of anaemia with iron overload caused by repeated blood transfusions and in children 2 to 5 years of age.

DESIROX 250MG TABLET is also used when deferoxamine therapy is contraindicated or inadequate for patients aged 10 years or older who have iron overload associated with non-transfusion-dependent thalassaemia syndromes. Your doctor may advise you to undergo relevant tests to analyze your existing condition and monitor your kidney and liver function during management.

DESIROX 250MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with moderate to severe kidney disease, severe liver disease, advanced stage of myelodysplastic syndrome (decreased production of blood cells by the bone marrow) or advanced stage of cancer.

Inform your doctor if you have heart disease. DESIROX 250MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women, unless recommended by your doctor. DESIROX 250MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children under 2 years of age.

The most common side effects of taking DESIROX 250MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, abdominal pain, bloating, constipation, indigestion, rash, itching, headache, and change in liver or kidney function tests or urine tests. Consult your physician if any of your side effects get worse or persists for a longer duration.

DESIROX 250MG TABLET works by trapping and removing excess iron from the body, which is then excreted mainly in the form of stools and reduces the risk of organ damage to the liver and heart. As a result, DESIROX 250MG TABLET helps to remove excess iron from the body.

Introduction About RYZE 4 MG FROSTY MINT NICOTINE GUM

RYZE 4 MG FROSTY MINT NICOTINE GUM is designed to support individuals who are working towards reducing nicotine dependence. RYZE 4 MG FROSTY MINT NICOTINE GUM offer a refreshing mint flavour and easy-to-use format. It is ideal for adults who are looking for a smoke-free alternative that can be used discreetly during work, travel, or social interactions.

The sugar-free formulation helps those mindful of calorie intake, and the 4mg strength is generally suited for individuals who used to consume more than 20 cigarettes a day. Always follow your healthcare provider’s guidance on dosage and usage schedule.

RYZE 4 MG FROSTY MINT NICOTINE GUM is a nicotine replacement therapy. It helps to quit smoking by replacing the deficient levels of nicotine in your body that happen when you attempt to quit smoking. As a result, it reduces cravings for smoking and protects your body from the harmful effects of abusive substances.

Chew the gum slowly until you experience a peppery taste or mild tingling. Park the gum between your cheek and gums. Repeat the chewing-parking cycle for about 30 minutes. Avoid eating or drinking anything acidic (like coffee, soft drinks) 15 minutes before or after use.

Before using RYZE 4 MG FROSTY MINT NICOTINE GUM inform your healthcare provider if you are pregnant, breastfeeding, or have underlying conditions. Do not use if you are allergic to nicotine.  

While many individuals may use RYZE 4 MG FROSTY MINT NICOTINE GUM without notable concerns, some may experience mild effects, especially in the initial phase of use. Always follow usage directions and consult a healthcare professional in case of any discomfort.

introduction:
Introduction About RENOSAVE P TABLET

RENOSAVE P TABLET contains Acetylcysteine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Mucolytics. It is used in adults to manage acute airway diseases such as bronchitis (inflammation of the mucous membrane in the airways), emphysema, mucoviscidosis (cystic fibrosis), and/or bronchiectasis (chronic widening of the airway passage).

RENOSAVE P TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Acetylcysteine. It is also not recommended for use in patients with bronchial asthma. Before taking RENOSAVE P TABLET, inform your doctor if you have stomach ulcers, liver diseases (such as non-alcoholic fatty acid disease), or chronic kidney disease.

RENOSAVE P TABLET should be used with caution by pregnant and breastfeeding women only if it is clearly necessary. This medicine is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years) and is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 60 years) after consulting your doctor. The most common side effects of taking RENOSAVE P TABLET are nausea and vomiting. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.

RENOSAVE P TABLET works by enhancing airway secretions and mucociliary function (a defense mechanism of the lungs that promotes movement and removal of excess mucus), which causes the mucus (phlegm) to become less sticky, resulting in its easy removal through cough, thus managing airway diseases in affected individuals.

introduction:
Introduction About ACUTROL C 800MG TABLET

ACUTROL C 800MG TABLET contains Sevelamer, which belongs to the group of medicines called Phosphate Binding Agents. It is used to control the serum phosphorous levels in patients with long-term kidney disease who are on dialysis. Renal failure is the most common cause of high phosphorous levels, as there is reduced filtration of inorganic phosphate, increasing its serum levels.

During management, your doctor might ask you to take certain tests to avoid any untoward side effects. Follow the diet as advised by your doctor.

ACUTROL C 800MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with low levels of phosphorus in the blood or bowel obstruction. ACUTROL C 800MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients who have trouble swallowing, motility problems in the stomach and bowel, and in those who have undergone major bowel surgery.

ACUTROL C 800MG TABLET should be used in pregnant women only if your doctor finds it clearly necessary. It is unknown whether ACUTROL C 800MG TABLET is excreted in breast milk and may affect your baby, so consult your doctor before taking it during breastfeeding.  ACUTROL C 800MG TABLET is not intended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking ACUTROL C 800MG TABLET are constipation, vomiting, upper abdominal pain, nausea, diarrhea, indigestion, flatulence (gas), etc. Ask for your doctor’s advice if any of these worsen or don’t improve.

introduction:
Introduction About RECOPIL 250 TABLET

RECOPIL 250 TABLET contains Disulfiram which belongs to the group of medicines called Aldehyde Dehydrogenase Inhibitors. It is used to manage in patients with alcohol dependence (or alcohol addiction). It helps to manage the habit of alcoholism in patients having a habit of drinking excessive alcohol (chronic alcoholism). RECOPIL 250 TABLET helps in reducing alcohol dependence. It creates aversion towards alcohol by creating various unpleasant symptoms (such as flushing, burning sensation, throbbing headache, increased sweating, chest tightness, dizziness, vomiting, visual disturbances and confusion).

Before taking RECOPIL 250 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any lung, liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, high or low blood pressure, thyroid problems, brain damage, fits or any mental disorders as a precaution. RECOPIL 250 TABLET should not be used in patients who have already consumed alcohol. It should be used only in patients who have not drunk alcohol for at least 24 hours prior to the first dose.

It is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in children (aged below 18 years). The most common side effects of taking RECOPIL 250 TABLET are drowsiness, tiredness, impotence, low sex drive, headache, sleepiness and metallic taste. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Used to manage in patients with alcohol dependence (or alcohol addiction)
usesDetails:
Uses Of RECOPIL 250 TABLET
Used to manage in patients with alcohol dependence (or alcohol addiction)
mechanismOfAction:
How RECOPIL 250 TABLET Works

RECOPIL 250 TABLET helps in reducing alcohol dependence. It acts by blocking the actions of certain enzymes (such as aldehyde dehydrogenase) within the body that helps in breaking down a substance called acetaldehyde. As a result, it leads to the accumulation of an excessive amount of acetaldehyde in the body causing unpleasant physical reactions (such as flushing, burning sensation, throbbing headache, increased sweating, chest tightness, dizziness, vomiting, visual disturbances and confusion) that can create aversion towards alcohol which will eventually help in quitting alcoholism.
usageDetails:
How to use RECOPIL 250 TABLET

Take RECOPIL 250 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Do not consume alcohol for at least 24 hours before taking the first dose of RECOPIL 250 TABLET. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About NICOTEX 4MG SUGAR FREE MINT PLUS FLAVOUR GUM

NICOTEX 4MG SUGAR FREE MINT PLUS FLAVOUR GUM is designed to support individuals who are working towards reducing nicotine dependence. NICOTEX 4MG SUGAR FREE MINT PLUS FLAVOUR GUM offer a refreshing mint flavour and easy-to-use format. It is ideal for adults who are looking for a smoke-free alternative that can be used discreetly during work, travel, or social interactions.

The sugar-free formulation helps those mindful of calorie intake, and the 4mg strength is generally suited for individuals who used to consume more than 20 cigarettes a day. Always follow your healthcare provider’s guidance on dosage and usage schedule.

NICOTEX 4MG SUGAR FREE MINT PLUS FLAVOUR GUM is a nicotine replacement therapy. It helps to quit smoking by replacing the deficient levels of nicotine in your body that happen when you attempt to quit smoking. As a result, it reduces cravings for smoking and protects your body from the harmful effects of abusive substances.

Chew the gum slowly until you experience a peppery taste or mild tingling. Park the gum between your cheek and gums. Repeat the chewing-parking cycle for about 30 minutes. Avoid eating or drinking anything acidic (like coffee, soft drinks) 15 minutes before or after use.

Before using NICOTEX 4MG SUGAR FREE MINT PLUS FLAVOUR GUM inform your healthcare provider if you are pregnant, breastfeeding, or have underlying conditions. Do not use if you are allergic to nicotine.  

While many individuals may use NICOTEX 4MG SUGAR FREE MINT PLUS FLAVOUR GUM without notable concerns, some may experience mild effects, especially in the initial phase of use. Always follow usage directions and consult a healthcare professional in case of any discomfort.

It does not deliver the harmful components of tobacco smoke (e.g., tar, carbon monoxide).

introduction:
Introduction About DEFRIJET 500MG TABLET

DEFRIJET 500MG TABLET contains Deferasirox which belongs to the group of medicines called Iron chelators. DEFRIJET 500MG TABLET is used to remove chronic iron overload (excess iron in the body) caused by frequent blood transfusions in patients with Beta thalassemia major aged 6 years and older. DEFRIJET 500MG TABLET is also used to manage chronic iron overload when deferoxamine therapy is contraindicated or inadequate in patients with beta thalassaemia major and other types of anaemia with iron overload caused by repeated blood transfusions and in children 2 to 5 years of age.

DEFRIJET 500MG TABLET is also used when deferoxamine therapy is contraindicated or inadequate for patients aged 10 years or older who have iron overload associated with non-transfusion-dependent thalassaemia syndromes. Your doctor may advise you to undergo relevant tests to analyze your existing condition and monitor your kidney and liver function during management.

DEFRIJET 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with moderate to severe kidney disease, severe liver disease, advanced stage of myelodysplastic syndrome (decreased production of blood cells by the bone marrow) or advanced stage of cancer.

Inform your doctor if you have heart disease. DEFRIJET 500MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women, unless recommended by your doctor. DEFRIJET 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children under 2 years of age.

The most common side effects of taking DEFRIJET 500MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, abdominal pain, bloating, constipation, indigestion, rash, itching, headache, and change in liver or kidney function tests or urine tests. Consult your physician if any of your side effects get worse or persists for a longer duration.
uses: Chronic iron overload due to blood transfusion (transfusional haemosiderosis) in patients aged 2 years and above

mechanismOfAction:
How DEFRIJET 500MG TABLET Works

DEFRIJET 500MG TABLET works by trapping and removing excess iron from the body, which is then excreted mainly in the form of stools and reduces the risk of organ damage to the liver and heart. As a result, DEFRIJET 500MG TABLET helps to remove excess iron from the body.
usageDetails:
How to use DEFRIJET 500MG TABLET

Take DEFRIJET 500MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your physician will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About NICOSIP 4MG FRUIT BLAST FLAVOUR GUM

NICOSIP 4MG FRUIT BLAST FLAVOUR GUM is designed to support individuals who are working towards reducing nicotine dependence. NICOSIP 4MG FRUIT BLAST FLAVOUR GUM offer a refreshing mint flavour and easy-to-use format. It is ideal for adults who are looking for a smoke-free alternative that can be used discreetly during work, travel, or social interactions.

The sugar-free formulation helps those mindful of calorie intake, and the 4mg strength is generally suited for individuals who used to consume more than 20 cigarettes a day. Always follow your healthcare provider’s guidance on dosage and usage schedule.

NICOSIP 4MG FRUIT BLAST FLAVOUR GUM is a nicotine replacement therapy. It helps to quit smoking by replacing the deficient levels of nicotine in your body that happen when you attempt to quit smoking. As a result, it reduces cravings for smoking and protects your body from the harmful effects of abusive substances.

Chew the gum slowly until you experience a peppery taste or mild tingling. Park the gum between your cheek and gums. Repeat the chewing-parking cycle for about 30 minutes. Avoid eating or drinking anything acidic (like coffee, soft drinks) 15 minutes before or after use.

Before using NICOSIP 4MG FRUIT BLAST FLAVOUR GUM inform your healthcare provider if you are pregnant, breastfeeding, or have underlying conditions. Do not use if you are allergic to nicotine.  

While many individuals may use NICOSIP 4MG FRUIT BLAST FLAVOUR GUM without notable concerns, some may experience mild effects, especially in the initial phase of use. Always follow usage directions and consult a healthcare professional in case of any discomfort.

How Nicotine Is Delivered Through Gum?

NICOSIP 4MG FRUIT BLAST FLAVOUR GUM contains nicotine (4mg) that, when chewed, is absorbed through the buccal mucosa (lining of the mouth). This controlled release helps the body receive small amounts of nicotine, helping individuals who are working to manage cravings during nicotine reduction efforts. It does not deliver the harmful components of tobacco smoke (e.g., tar, carbon monoxide).

Common

introduction:
Introduction About DEFERASIROX 500 TABLET

DEFERASIROX 500 TABLET contains Deferasirox which belongs to the group of medicines called Iron chelators. DEFERASIROX 500 TABLET is used to remove chronic iron overload (excess iron in the body) caused by frequent blood transfusions in patients with Beta thalassemia major aged 6 years and older. DEFERASIROX 500 TABLET is also used to manage chronic iron overload when deferoxamine therapy is contraindicated or inadequate in patients with beta thalassaemia major and other types of anaemia with iron overload caused by repeated blood transfusions and in children 2 to 5 years of age.

DEFERASIROX 500 TABLET is also used when deferoxamine therapy is contraindicated or inadequate for patients aged 10 years or older who have iron overload associated with non-transfusion-dependent thalassaemia syndromes. Your doctor may advise you to undergo relevant tests to analyze your existing condition and monitor your kidney and liver function during management.

DEFERASIROX 500 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with moderate to severe kidney disease, severe liver disease, advanced stage of myelodysplastic syndrome (decreased production of blood cells by the bone marrow) or advanced stage of cancer.

Inform your doctor if you have heart disease. DEFERASIROX 500 TABLET is generally not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women, unless recommended by your doctor. DEFERASIROX 500 TABLET is not recommended for use in children under 2 years of age.

The most common side effects of taking DEFERASIROX 500 TABLET are nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, abdominal pain, bloating, constipation, indigestion, rash, itching, headache, and change in liver or kidney function tests or urine tests. mechanismOfAction:
How DEFERASIROX 500 TABLET Works

DEFERASIROX 500 TABLET works by trapping and removing excess iron from the body, which is then excreted mainly in the form of stools and reduces the risk of organ damage to the liver and heart. As a result, DEFERASIROX 500 TABLET helps to remove excess iron from the body.

Take DEFERASIROX 500 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your physician will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About ATROFINE INJECTION

ATROFINE INJECTION contains Atropine which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-cholinergic drugs. It is used to restore normal heartbeat during an event of cardiac arrest (heart stops working suddenly). It is often used as a preanesthetic medication to manage the risk of sudden decrease in heartbeat and to reduce saliva secretions during surgical procedures. It can also be used in the poisoning caused due to certain substances like insecticides or mushrooms. It is used in combination with other medicines to reverse the effects of certain muscle relaxants (like vecuronium, rocuronium) given during surgery. It can also reduce the overactivity of certain medicines (muscle relaxants) used in the management of severe muscle disorders like myasthenia gravis.

Atropine is an antimuscarinic agent. It works by blocking the effects of a neurotransmitter called acetylcholine, which is responsible for causing contraction of muscles, increase in body secretions, and decrease in heart rate. As a result, it leads to stimulation of muscles, increase in heart rate, and decrease in body secretions.

ATROFINE INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients suffering from closed-angle glaucoma (increased eye pressure), an enlarged prostate, myasthenia gravis, or any obstruction of gut. If you are pregnant or breastfeeding, consult your doctor for advice before receiving ATROFINE INJECTION. The most common side effects of ATROFINE INJECTION are dry mouth, reduced sweating, blurred vision, constipation, increased heart rate and confusion. Consult your doctor if any of the symptom worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How ATROFINE INJECTION Works

ATROFINE INJECTION is an antimuscarinic agent. It effectively restores cardiac activity and body function by blocking the effects of a neurotransmitter called acetylcholine in the body which is responsible for various physiological functions (such as contraction of skeletal or smooth muscles, increase in body secretions or bowel movements, and decrease in heart rate). As a result, ATROFINE INJECTION stimulates skeletal muscles, increases heart rate and reduces body secretions (such saliva, sweat, bronchial and intestinal secretion) and bowel movements. This helps in restoring cardiac activity during fatal conditions like cardiac arrest or poisoning, reduces salivary secretion during surgical procedures and stimulates muscle movements by counteracting the effects of muscle relaxants.
usageDetails:
How to use ATROFINE INJECTION

ATROFINE INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse either into the vein (intravenously), muscle (intramuscularly), under the skin (subcutaneously) or into the trachea (via endotracheal tube). Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

ATROFINE INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with heart diseases (such as high blood pressure, fast or irregular heartbeat, angina, or heart failure) and in patients who had a heart transplantation. Consult your doctor before receiving.

ATROFINE INJECTION should be used with caution in children and adolescent (below 18 years), especially if they suffer from fever or when surrounded by hot climate. Others

Have myasthenia gravis (severe muscle weakness)
Have toxic megacolon (swollen and inflamed colon causing stomach pain, bloating and fever)
Have reflux esophagitis (inflammation of food pipe due to reflux of stomach acid)
Have blockade or narrowing in the gut (ex. pyloric stenosis)
Have paralytic ileus (paralysis of intestines that causes severe constipation and bloating)
Have glaucoma (increased pressure in the eye)
Have enlargement of the prostate gland

Before receiving ATROFINE INJECTION, inform your doctor if you:

Have problems in mental and physical growth (ex. down's syndrome)
Have an overactive thyroid gland
Have diarrhea, heart burn or indigestion
Have nerve damage
Have ulcers or infections in the stomach or intestines
Have hiatus hernia (protrusion of upper part of stomach into the chest)
Have fever

introduction:
Introduction About ASUNRA 400MG TABLET

ASUNRA 400MG TABLET contains Deferasirox which belongs to the group of medicines called Iron chelators. ASUNRA 400MG TABLET is used to remove chronic iron overload (excess iron in the body) caused by frequent blood transfusions in patients with Beta thalassemia major aged 6 years and older. ASUNRA 400MG TABLET is also used to manage chronic iron overload when deferoxamine therapy is contraindicated or inadequate in patients with beta thalassaemia major and other types of anaemia with iron overload caused by repeated blood transfusions and in children 2 to 5 years of age.

ASUNRA 400MG TABLET is also used when deferoxamine therapy is contraindicated or inadequate for patients aged 10 years or older who have iron overload associated with non-transfusion-dependent thalassaemia syndromes. Your doctor may advise you to undergo relevant tests to analyze your existing condition and monitor your kidney and liver function during management.

ASUNRA 400MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with moderate to severe kidney disease, severe liver disease, advanced stage of myelodysplastic syndrome (decreased production of blood cells by the bone marrow) or advanced stage of cancer.

Inform your doctor if you have heart disease. ASUNRA 400MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women, unless recommended by your doctor. ASUNRA 400MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children under 2 years of age.

The most common side effects of taking ASUNRA 400MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, abdominal pain, bloating, constipation, indigestion, rash, itching, headache, and change in liver or kidney function tests or urine tests. Consult your physician if any of your side effects get worse or persists for a longer duration.

name: Champix (Maintenance Pack) 1mg Tablet 28'S
introduction:
Introduction About CHAMPIX (MAINTENANCE PACK) 1MG TABLET

CHAMPIX (MAINTENANCE PACK) 1MG TABLET contains Varenicline, which belongs to the group of medicines called Smoking cessation aids. It is used by adults to help them stop smoking. It can help relieve the craving and withdrawal symptoms associated with stopping smoking. It can also reduce the enjoyment of cigarettes if you do smoke while on management.

CHAMPIX (MAINTENANCE PACK) 1MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with kidney, heart problems, fits, psychiatric disorders. Consult your doctor before taking it.

CHAMPIX (MAINTENANCE PACK) 1MG TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant women. It is generally not recommended for use by breastfeeding women unless it is considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before taking it.

CHAMPIX (MAINTENANCE PACK) 1MG TABLET is not recommended for use with children. It should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and older). Consult your doctor before taking it.

The most common side effects of taking CHAMPIX (MAINTENANCE PACK) 1MG TABLET are inflammation of the nose and throat, abnormal dreams, difficulty sleeping, headaches, and nausea. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About NICOTEX MINT PLUS FLAVOUR 4MG CHEW GUM TABLET

NICOTEX MINT PLUS FLAVOUR 4MG CHEW GUM TABLET contains Nicotine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Smoking Cessation Aids. It is used to quit smoking. It avoids and relieves the withdrawal symptoms that occur in people who wish to quit smoking. It also reduces cravings for smoking when you try to reduce the number of cigarettes that you smoke in a day.

Smoking is a harmful practice in which abusive substances (such as tobacco) are burned and ingested in the form of smoke. Tobacco contains a chemical called nicotine, which makes you smoke more. Within seconds of taking a puff, nicotine from the tobacco reaches your brain and increases the release of certain brain chemicals that regulate your mood and behaviour. Over a period, this causes addiction, and your body tends to show cravings for smoking or precipitate withdrawal symptoms if you try to quit smoking.

NICOTEX MINT PLUS FLAVOUR 4MG CHEW GUM TABLET is a nicotine replacement therapy. It helps to quit smoking by replacing the deficient levels of nicotine in your body that happen when you attempt to quit smoking. As a result, it reduces cravings for smoking and protects your body from the harmful effects of abusive substances (such as tobacco).

Chew NICOTEX MINT PLUS FLAVOUR 4MG CHEW GUM TABLET slowly in your mouth. Do not swallow the medicine. Your doctor will decide the number of doses to be taken per day depending upon the number of cigarettes that you smoke in a day.

Before taking NICOTEX MINT PLUS FLAVOUR 4MG CHEW GUM TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any heart, liver, or kidney diseases. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, stomach problems, thyroid problems, or fits before taking NICOTEX MINT PLUS FLAVOUR 4MG CHEW GUM TABLET as a precaution.

Do not take NICOTEX MINT PLUS FLAVOUR 4MG CHEW GUM TABLET if you are allergic to nicotine or if you are a child aged below 12 years. Women who are pregnant or breastfeeding must try to quit smoking without using nicotine replacement therapy. However, if it is not possible, NICOTEX MINT PLUS FLAVOUR 4MG CHEW GUM TABLET can be used by such women to quit smoking after consulting their doctor.

The most common side effects of taking NICOTEX MINT PLUS FLAVOUR 4MG CHEW GUM TABLET are ulceration of the mouth, tongue, or throat, hiccups, nausea, increased salivation, and stomach pain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

Use NICOTEX MINT PLUS FLAVOUR 4MG CHEW GUM TABLET as directed by your physician. Chew NICOTEX MINT PLUS FLAVOUR 4MG CHEW GUM TABLET slowly until the taste becomes strong. Rest the medicine between your gums and cheeks for some time. Chew the medicine once again.

Introduction About CHAMPIX 0.5MG AND 1MG KIT

CHAMPIX 0.5MG AND 1MG KIT contains Varenicline, which belongs to the group of medicines called Smoking cessation aids. It is used by adults to help them stop smoking. It can help relieve the craving and withdrawal symptoms associated with stopping smoking. It can also reduce the enjoyment of cigarettes if you do smoke while on management.

CHAMPIX 0.5MG AND 1MG KIT should be used with caution in patients with kidney, heart problems, fits, psychiatric disorders. Consult your doctor before taking it.

CHAMPIX 0.5MG AND 1MG KIT is not recommended for use by pregnant women. It is generally not recommended for use by breastfeeding women unless it is considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before taking it.

CHAMPIX 0.5MG AND 1MG KIT is not recommended for use with children. It should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and older). Consult your doctor before taking it.

The most common side effects of taking CHAMPIX 0.5MG AND 1MG KIT are inflammation of the nose and throat, abnormal dreams, difficulty sleeping, headaches, and nausea. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

name: REOPIN Injection 1ml
introduction:
Introduction About REOPIN INJECTION

REOPIN INJECTION contains Atropine which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-cholinergic drugs. It is used to restore normal heartbeat during an event of cardiac arrest (heart stops working suddenly). It is often used as a preanesthetic medication to manage the risk of sudden decrease in heartbeat and to reduce saliva secretions during surgical procedures. It can also be used in the poisoning caused due to certain substances like insecticides or mushrooms. It is used in combination with other medicines to reverse the effects of certain muscle relaxants (like vecuronium, rocuronium) given during surgery. It can also reduce the overactivity of certain medicines (muscle relaxants) used in the management of severe muscle disorders like myasthenia gravis.

Atropine is an antimuscarinic agent. It works by blocking the effects of a neurotransmitter called acetylcholine, which is responsible for causing contraction of muscles, increase in body secretions, and decrease in heart rate. As a result, it leads to stimulation of muscles, increase in heart rate, and decrease in body secretions.

REOPIN INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients suffering from closed-angle glaucoma (increased eye pressure), an enlarged prostate, myasthenia gravis, or any obstruction of gut. If you are pregnant or breastfeeding, consult your doctor for advice before receiving REOPIN INJECTION. The most common side effects of REOPIN INJECTION are dry mouth, reduced sweating, blurred vision, constipation, increased heart rate and confusion. Consult your doctor if any of the symptom worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How REOPIN INJECTION Works

REOPIN INJECTION is an antimuscarinic agent. It effectively restores cardiac activity and body function by blocking the effects of a neurotransmitter called acetylcholine in the body which is responsible for various physiological functions (such as contraction of skeletal or smooth muscles, increase in body secretions or bowel movements, and decrease in heart rate). As a result, REOPIN INJECTION stimulates skeletal muscles, increases heart rate and reduces body secretions (such saliva, sweat, bronchial and intestinal secretion) and bowel movements. This helps in restoring cardiac activity during fatal conditions like cardiac arrest or poisoning, reduces salivary secretion during surgical procedures and stimulates muscle movements by counteracting the effects of muscle relaxants.
usageDetails:
How to use REOPIN INJECTION

REOPIN INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse either into the vein (intravenously), muscle (intramuscularly), under the skin (subcutaneously) or into the trachea (via endotracheal tube). Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

REOPIN INJECTION should be used in breastfeeding mothers only if it is clearly necessary by your doctor. Your doctor will prescribe REOPIN INJECTION only if the benefits are greater than any possible risk to the breastfeeding infant. Therefore, consult your doctor before receiving.

REOPIN INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with heart diseases (such as high blood pressure, fast or irregular heartbeat, angina, or heart failure) and in patients who had a heart transplantation. Consult your doctor before receiving.

REOPIN INJECTION should be used with caution in children and adolescent (below 18 years), especially if they suffer from fever or when surrounded by hot climate. REOPIN INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients (65 years and above). Consult your doctor before receiving.

Have myasthenia gravis (severe muscle weakness)
Have toxic megacolon (swollen and inflamed colon causing stomach pain, bloating and fever)
Have reflux esophagitis (inflammation of food pipe due to reflux of stomach acid)
Have blockade or narrowing in the gut (ex. pyloric stenosis)
Have paralytic ileus (paralysis of intestines that causes severe constipation and bloating)
Have glaucoma (increased pressure in the eye)
Have enlargement of the prostate gland

Have problems in mental and physical growth (ex. down's syndrome)
Have an overactive thyroid gland
Have diarrhea, heart burn or indigestion
Have nerve damage
Have ulcers or infections in the stomach or intestines
Have hiatus hernia (protrusion of upper part of stomach into the chest)
Have fever
